summary: FLUX.2 dev. Ryan on its hosted output, 2026-08-12: 'It looks like someone actually painted' it. Open weights — but the most expensive still renderer in this catalog by a wide margin.
vramNote: ESTIMATE. 33GB model + 16.8GB text encoder is 50GB of weights BEFORE activations. This does NOT fit a 32GB card. THE SURPRISE: FLUX.2's text encoder is Mistral-3-Small, 16.8GB in fp8 — flux1-dev-fp8 bundled its encoders into a single 16GB file, so the whole FLUX.2 stack is ~3x the older one.
cheaperVariant: mistral_3_small_flux2_fp4_mixed.safetensors is 11.43GB, taking the stack to 44.8GB. Try it before renting a bigger card — the encoder is the swing factor, not the model.
note: LICENCE: FLUX.2 dev is non-commercial. Fine for testing and for Ryan's own films; NOT fine if this ever becomes a paid product. flux1-dev + USO (17.3GB total) remains the cheap proven path and is what rendered every frame Ryan has approved.
decision: Hosted flux-2-dev on Replicate costs cents per image and needs no box. Self-hosting it only pays off at volume, and at 50GB it is the LAST model worth self-hosting, not the first.
